skill.name: conthunt
skill.description: Use the ContHunt CLI to discover and research viral social content on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts through SearchAgent, direct search, boards, analysis, insights, and deep research. Use when the user mentions ContHunt, conthunt CLI, viral social research, TikTok/Instagram/YouTube Shorts discovery, SearchAgent, or evidence-backed content research.
skill.summary: Research viral short-form social content with the ContHunt CLI.
skill.author: synthenova

security_audit.summary: Most alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks or unrelated prose. Remote installers are piped directly into shells, and the skill treats a broad use request as installation consent. SearchAgent may also initiate multiple paid searches without a stated preflight limit.

remediation.issue: Remote installation scripts execute without local inspection or integrity verification.
remediation.suggestion: Download a versioned installer, verify its published checksum or signature, show the source, and execute it only after explicit user confirmation.

remediation.issue: A request to use ContHunt is treated as authorization to install external software.
remediation.suggestion: Request explicit installation approval and identify the source, destination, permissions, and commands before changing the user environment.

remediation.issue: SearchAgent can initiate multiple paid searches without a stated spending limit.
remediation.suggestion: Explain that searches consume credits, obtain approval before paid work, and accept a user-defined search or credit limit.

content.user_title: Research Viral Short-Form Content with ContHunt
content.value_statement: Finding useful short-form social content across platforms requires repeated searches and organized evidence. This skill guides ContHunt searches, analysis, boards, and research workflows.
actual_capabilities: Runs direct searches across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
Uses SearchAgent to explore a niche and refine search queries.
Tracks asynchronous search, analysis, insight, and research jobs.
Organizes selected content into boards and retrieves board insights.
Retrieves question-focused evidence from analyzed videos.
Returns machine-readable results and preserves identifiers for later commands.
limitations: Requires the external ContHunt CLI, an authenticated account, and available credits.
Search coverage and metadata depend on ContHunt and its platform providers.
Region filters select provider proxy locations, not verified creator origins.
The supplied installation commands execute remote scripts without local integrity verification.

use_cases.title: Find Campaign References
use_cases.description: Discover high-performing short videos in a niche and collect useful examples for campaign planning.

use_cases.title: Compare Competitor Patterns
use_cases.description: Search competitor topics, organize selected videos, and identify repeated formats, hooks, and audience signals.

use_cases.title: Build Evidence-Based Briefs
use_cases.description: Analyze relevant videos and retrieve focused evidence for editorial or creative briefs.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Basic Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Search ContHunt for [topic] on [platform]. Show the strongest results and summarize why each result is relevant.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner has a topic and platform.

prompt_templates.title: Explore a Content Niche
prompt_templates.prompt: Use SearchAgent to explore [niche]. Ask before paid searches, limit work to [limit], and summarize promising themes with supporting results.
prompt_templates.scenario: A user needs guided niche discovery.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Selected Board
prompt_templates.prompt: Create or use board [board name]. Add the selected items, run insights, and compare their hooks, formats, and audience signals.
prompt_templates.scenario: A strategist wants patterns across chosen videos.

prompt_templates.title: Conduct Deep Evidence Research
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [question] using search [search ID] or board [board ID]. Track completion, review watched items, and return evidence with source identifiers.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs a traceable research brief.

output_examples.input: Find recent TikTok and Reels examples about home coffee brewing.
output_examples.output: A ranked result summary with platform, engagement context, content theme, and a saved search identifier for each result set.

output_examples.input: Compare the videos saved on my product-launch board.
output: Common hooks introduce a specific problem within the opening seconds.
Demonstrations outperform static explanations across the selected items.
The board and content identifiers remain available for follow-up analysis.

output_examples.input: Research which creator formats explain budgeting concepts clearly.
output_examples.output: An evidence-based brief covering recurring formats, selected examples, limitations, and source identifiers for further review.

best_practices: Confirm platforms, date ranges, regions, and paid-search limits before starting.
Use machine-readable output and preserve returned identifiers for follow-up commands.
Poll job status at reasonable intervals and retrieve full results only after completion.
anti_patterns: Do not execute remote installation scripts without inspection, verification, and explicit approval.
Do not repeat paid operations after credits are exhausted or when a start result is uncertain.
Do not expose authentication tokens, signed media URLs, or unnecessary raw payloads.

faq.question: Which platforms can this skill research?
faq.answer: It supports TikTok videos, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts through ContHunt.

faq.question: Does the skill require a ContHunt account?
faq.answer: Yes. The CLI requires authentication, and some searches or research operations consume account credits.

faq.question: Can it run a search immediately?
faq.answer: Yes. Direct search accepts a defined query and platform scope, while SearchAgent explores broader briefs.

faq.question: How does it handle long operations?
faq.answer: It starts background work, checks status, and retrieves results after completion.

faq.question: Can it analyze any social media URL?
faq.answer: No. Analysis requires a stored ContHunt media asset identifier rather than a direct social or CDN URL.

faq.question: Does it download media files?
faq.answer: Yes. The download command can save a stored media asset to a user-selected local path.
